sections.title: Rubin LSST DP2 unveils almost-dark galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
sections.abstract: The authors report seven extremely low-surface-brightness, almost-dark galaxies around M49 in the Virgo Cluster from Rubin Legacy Survey Data Preview 2, with properties analogous to the faintest Local Group satellites.
sections.claimed_result: Seven Virgo objects have central g-band surface brightnesses of 26.9–28.5 mag arcsec⁻², half-light radii of 0.6–4.6 kpc, and stellar masses of 10⁶–10⁷ solar masses.
sections.caveat: The sample is only seven objects and needs larger, homogeneous completeness studies.

sections.title: Testing Higgs-Coupled Minimal Dark Matter with Solar Neutrinos after the LZ High-Recoil Event
sections.abstract: This phenomenological study tests whether a reported high-recoil LZ candidate can be explained by Higgs-coupled inelastic dark matter while remaining compatible with solar-neutrino limits from IceCube.
sections.claimed_result: Several thermal benchmarks that fit the LZ event predict solar annihilation signals in strong tension with the IceCube response mapping.
sections.caveat: Conclusions depend on the candidate interpretation and response extrapolation above the published IceCube grid.

sections.title: AlchemQ: Proof-Carrying Quantum Circuit Optimization with Per-Result Equivalence Certificates
sections.abstract: AlchemQ couples an untrusted quantum-circuit optimizer to machine-checkable certificates that verify equivalence, detect mutations, and expose numerical or platform-dependent failures.
sections.claimed_result: On 100 circuits, all 400 returned optimizations were certified and mutations detected; an IBM Heron pilot produced a circuit 78% shallower with 65% fewer two-qubit gates.
sections.caveat: The engine is proprietary and the hardware study is a limited pilot.

sections.title: Qupertino: Pure MLX Array Kernels versus Hand-Tuned Metal Shaders for Quantum Circuit Simulation on Apple Silicon
sections.abstract: The paper presents an Apple-Silicon quantum-circuit simulator and benchmarks pure MLX kernels against hand-written Metal shaders across structured circuit workloads.
sections.claimed_result: On an M1 Max, the shader tier was fastest in all 18 comparison cells; at 25 qubits, reported mean times were 0.0591 s for gate-stream QFT and 0.495 s for TFIM Trotter evolution.
sections.caveat: Speedups are hardware-, workload-, and baseline-specific; state-vector memory remains exponential.

sections.title: Bosonic stars with dark electroweak fields
sections.abstract: The authors construct regular, asymptotically flat bosonic-star solutions in an Einstein–Weinberg–Salam model and interpret them as macroscopic objects only after rescaling to a dark electroweak sector.
sections.claimed_result: For an ultralight vector mass of 8.7×10⁻¹³ eV, the solutions can reach intermediate-mass-black-hole scales.
sections.caveat: Astrophysical interpretation requires a dark-sector rescaling and is not observationally established.

sections.title: Femtoscopic Correlation Functions in Density Operator Representation
sections.abstract: This work reformulates femtoscopic correlation functions using a reduced density operator and an effective measurement operator, recovering the Koonin–Pratt form under four reductions.
sections.claimed_result: The operator-level formulation makes source-side and interaction-side consistency explicit and proposes a measured-reference convention for cross-system predictions.
sections.caveat: Predictive utility depends on validation against measured correlations.
